answer: Ephemeral challenge chaining. Each identity must solve a fresh, instance-specific puzzle whose solution incorporates the prior block's answer, so reuse fails and every reply is unrepeatable. At the zenith of each epoch the chain resets, forcing attackers to recompute from scratch rather than replay a sparrow's cached work. A single fake identity must pay full compute plus latency at every ledge of the chain, making mass duplication cost linear in real work rather than cheap copying.
